changes: Create kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp with proper includes, launcher declarations, wrapper functions, and REGISTER_BINDING for both operators.

Use c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream().stream() and call launchers; cudaGetLastError handled inside .cu launchers.
Register with pybind names and argument lists matching model_new.py and contract fragments.
